name: Matreier Tauernhaus
beschreibung: The Matreier Tauernhaus is a traditional inn in the Tauerntal near Matrei in Osttirol, directly at the edge of the Nationalpark Hohe Tauern. The accommodation is situated at an altitude of around 1,500 metres and offers access to extensive hiking trails and tours. The guest rooms are functional and furnished in an alpine style. The inn is aimed primarily at active holidaymakers such as mountain hikers, cyclists and ski tourers. In the in-house restaurant, regional Tiroler dishes are served, based on products from the surrounding area. The atmosphere at the inn is quiet and close to nature.
